format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is the SIMAI Framework's tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs through tests/browser/package-manifest-probes.browser.mjs

probes.title: after the host's answer: state ready, total 3, three rows

steps.script: (() => { window.__calls = []; const records = [{id: '1', revision: '1', actions: ['view', 'delete'], title: 'Портал клиента'}, {id: '2', revision: '1', actions: ['view', 'delete'], title: 'Каталог товаров'}, {id: '3', revision: '1', actions: ['view'], title: 'Склад'}]; const port = {id: 'simai.dataview-port', version: '1.12.0', capabilities: ['row-actions'], raise: async (intent, payload) => { window.__calls.push(intent); if (intent === 'query.change') return {answer: 'applied', sequence: payload.sequence, data: {records: records.map((one) => ({...one})), columns: [{key: 'title', label: 'Название', role: 'title'}], total: records.length, has_next: false, echo: {page: 1, per_page: 25}}}; if (intent === 'record.open') return {answer: 'applied', record_id: payload.record_ids?.[0]}; if (intent === 'record.mutate') { const at = records.findIndex((one) => one.id === payload.record_ids[0]); if (at >= 0) records.splice(at, 1); return {answer: 'applied'}; } return {answer: 'unavailable', reason: 'capability-not-provided'}; } }; document.getElementById('v').setHostPort(port); return true; })()
